roamseo.description: RoamSEO's hosted MCP server gives Claude Code live SEO data: keyword ideas with volume and difficulty, current Google results for a query, backlinks and ranked keywords for any domain, site audits, rank tracking and checks of how AI assistants mention a brand. Nothing runs locally; the client opens a browser sign-in (OAuth) on first use. A free account covers Search Console and Analytics reads; new search data costs credits.
